description.value: KeeLung Taiwanese Breakfast & Lunch is a quick-service Taiwanese restaurant in Richmond, specializing in traditional morning and midday dishes from Taiwan. Operating out of a unit in a larger commercial building at McKim Way, it serves the diverse Richmond community with Taiwanese breakfast staples — a cuisine not commonly found in fast-casual format in the region. A touring cyclist passing through Richmond's commercial district would find it a distinctive and filling stop during morning or early-afternoon riding hours.
